title: pvCONVERGECFDReader
body:
## pvCONVERGECFDReader

Reads CONVERGE CFD HDF5 post files (.h5) into a partitioned dataset collection: each stream in the file is a top-level group holding its mesh (cell data), surfaces and parcels (point clouds of spray or particle data). The reader detects a time series from files named <prefix><zero-padded index>[_<time>].h5 next to the chosen file and takes each file's time from its metadata. Use pvCONVERGECFDCGNSReader for CONVERGE output written as CGNS.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Name one file of the series; the other time steps are found by naming convention, so keep the files together and unrenamed.
- The VTK reader does not support parallel loading.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `CONVERGECFDReader`. Identity: `sources/CONVERGECFDReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Available cell variables. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The Converge CFD file name. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ParcelArrayStatus` | Available parcel variables. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCONVERGECFDReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
